verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centered structure, but the headline sits jammed right under the header band and the space between headline, body copy and CTA is cramped. The orange divider has slipped onto the body copy and shows as an underline under 'released in', which is a collision, and the logo is shrunk very small. B is clearly broken: the dark header band covers only the left half of the canvas, the whole right half is empty apart from a stray floating divider line, and the tiny legal text is stranded in the bottom-right corner, so the layout is badly lopsided.
